# first activate the ibd conda environment and the directory this code run is /mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/hmmIBD
```{bash}
cat hrp_status.txt | xargs -I {} -P 2 sh -c 'Rscript ~/software/malaria-hub/ibd/run_hmmIBD_per_category.R \
-d /mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/hmmIBD/hrp_status \
-b /mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/ethiopia_vcf/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.vqslod.filt.snps_ethiopia.mat.bin \
-m /mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/metadata/sample_meta_with_hrp_status_updated.csv \
-c {} \
--label_category hrp_status \
--label_fws fws \
--fws_th 0.95 \
--label_id Sample \
--maf 0.01 \
--na_char NA \
--remove_chr Pf3D7_API_v3,Pf_M76611'

```

```{r}
#install.packages(c("rmarkdown", "knitr"))
#install.packages("reticulate")
library(rmarkdown, help, pos = 2, lib.loc = NULL)
library(knitr, help, pos = 2, lib.loc = NULL)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr, help, pos = 2, lib.loc = NULL)
library(data.table)
library(reticulate, help, pos = 2, lib.loc = NULL)

hmmIBD_frac <- read.csv("/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/hmmIBD/hrp_status/01_03_2026_hmmIBD_ibd_win10kb_annotated_q0.95.tsv",sep="\t")
print(colnames(hmmIBD_frac))

for (i in unique(hmmIBD_frac$category)) {

    subset_df <- hmmIBD_frac %>%
        dplyr::filter(category == i)

    safe_i <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", i)

    write.table(
        subset_df,
        file = paste0(safe_i, "_01_03_2026_hmmIBD_ibd_win10kb_annotated_q0.95.tsv"),
        sep = "\t",
        row.names = FALSE,
        quote = FALSE
    )
}
```


```{bash}
awk 'BEGIN{FS=OFS="\t"} NR>1 {print $1, $2-1, $3}' mutant_01_03_2026_hmmIBD_ibd_win10kb_annotated_q0.95.tsv > mutant_output.bed
awk 'BEGIN{FS=OFS="\t"} NR>1 {print $1, $2-1, $3}' wild_01_03_2026_hmmIBD_ibd_win10kb_annotated_q0.95.tsv > wild_output.bed
awk 'BEGIN{FS=OFS="\t"} NR>1 {print $1, $2-1, $3}' hrp3_only_01_03_2026_hmmIBD_ibd_win10kb_annotated_q0.95.tsv > hrp3_only_output.bed


awk 'BEGIN{OFS="\t"} {print $0, "high_IBD"}' mutant_output.bed > output_mutant.bed
awk 'BEGIN{OFS="\t"} {print $0, "high_IBD"}' wild_output.bed > output_wild.bed
awk 'BEGIN{OFS="\t"} {print $0, "high_IBD"}' hrp3_only_output.bed > output_hrp3_only.bed



```

```{python}
# use this code for runnning for each catagory one by one 
python -m jcvi.graphics.chromosome output_mutant.bed \
    --size=pf.sizes --title="Ethiopia_newly_sequenced-high_IBD_regions_hrp_mutant" --gauge
```
